orchestrator_reply.instructions: The CTO asked an agent whether its tab or tabs are still needed. What does the reply in the state say?

criteria.done: The reply explicitly says its work is finished and its tab or tabs can be closed.
criteria.not_done: The reply says work continues or its tab or tabs are still needed.
criteria.unclear: The reply does not clearly say either.
